T: Sequins on the bus. Sandwiches in the esky.
D: Three drag performers drive a bus from Sydney to Alice Springs for a show.
P: Serve the snacks when the bus pulls into Broken Hill.
S: Mini lamb and rosemary pies under puff lids, eaten out of the heat.

Fry 1 diced onion and 2 crushed garlic cloves in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, add 500g lamb mince and brown for 8 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp flour, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 250ml beef stock and 2 tsp chopped rosemary and simmer 12 minutes until thick, then cool 15 minutes. Line a 12-hole muffin tin with shortcrust rounds, fill, top with puff lids, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until deep golden. Serve with tomato sauce.
Blue, green and purple cubes set in lemon jelly with edible glitter, sparkly enough for Felicia

Shimmering cubes of blue, green and purple jelly set inside clear lemon jelly and cut into chunks, with a little edible glitter like raw opal. Make three 85g packets of blue, green and purple jelly with 250ml boiling water each, set in shallow trays for 2 hours and cut into small cubes. Soak 6 gelatine leaves, dissolve in 500ml hot lemonade with 2 tbsp lemon juice and cool. Scatter the cubes into a lined 20cm tin, pour over the clear jelly and set 3 hours. Cut into chunks and dust with edible glitter.
Crumbed chicken, ham, napoli sauce and melted cheese in soft rolls.

Slice 2 chicken breasts (about 600g) into 8 thin steaks and flatten. Crumb through flour, 2 beaten eggs and 200g breadcrumbs, and shallow fry in 1cm of oil for 3 minutes a side. Put on a tray, top each with 1 tbsp napoli sauce, half a slice of ham and a pinch of grated cheese, and grill for 5 minutes until melted and bubbling. Serve in 8 soft slider rolls.
M: Thick snags, garlic lamb chops and fried onions off the tailgate while the bus gets fixed

Thick beef snags grilled slowly, rosemary and garlic lamb chops, fried onions and a tomato, cucumber and red onion salad, served on the tailgate. Marinate 8 lamb chops in olive oil, rosemary, 2 crushed garlic cloves and lemon zest for 30 minutes. Cook 8 thick beef sausages over medium coals for 15 minutes, turning. Fry 2 sliced onions on the hotplate with oil until soft and golden. Grill the chops 3 minutes a side. Toss 3 chopped tomatoes, 1 cucumber and half a red onion with oil, vinegar and salt. Serve with bread and sauce.
Seared kangaroo fillet with roast sweet potato wedges and warm plum sauce
Kangaroo fillet marinated in pepperberry, garlic and oil, seared hard to rare, rested, sliced, with a quandong or plum sauce and roast sweet potato.
W: Kings Canyon wattleseed and macadamia slice
Shortbread base, wattleseed caramel and macadamias, dark chocolate top.

Rub 150g cold butter into 225g plain flour and 60g sugar, press into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 170C for 20 minutes. Stir a 395g tin of condensed milk, 60g butter, 100g brown sugar and 1 tbsp ground wattleseed in a pot over medium heat for 10 minutes until thick and caramel coloured, fold in 100g chopped macadamias and spread over the base. Cool, pour over 150g melted dark chocolate and chill 60 minutes before cutting into squares.
K: Raspberry and peach purée topped with sparkling rosé

Fresh raspberry and peach purée topped with chilled sparkling rosé in flutes, a single raspberry dropped in each glass. Blend 150g raspberries with 1 ripe peach (or 200g tinned peaches, drained) and 1 tbsp sugar syrup until smooth, then strain. Spoon 30ml purée into each of 4 chilled flutes. Top slowly with 150ml cold sparkling rosé, stir once gently and drop in a raspberry. Use sparkling grape juice for an alcohol-free version.
